name: dssim
notes: 2026-11-01: Rust CLI scoring multi-scale SSIM dissimilarity with an optional difference map; tolerance gating for stills.
2026-11-01: Run as an external CLI only; never link into shipped code.
2026-11-01: Triage: assess. Report rates it worth cataloguing.

2026-11-24: Install corrected. PyPI dssim 1.3.0 is a discrete-event simulation framework (majvan), not this tool; the assessment's version_seen '1.3.0 (PyPI)' refers to that package. Install is Homebrew dssim (kornel.ski, 3.4.0).

evidence.result: Generated 256x256 opaque RGB PNG: self-score 0.00000000; JPEG q90, q50, q10 round trips 0.00087072, 0.02181509, 0.05846345 (same in reversed order); scale-0 difference maps 256x256, non-blank, mean 0.087, 0.342, 0.624; repeat run byte-identical; contact sheet inspected.
evidence.scope: Scores a generated opaque PNG against itself and its JPEG q90/q50/q10 versions, rerun-identical, with scale-0 maps; dssim 3.4.0, macOS arm64. Not alpha, thresholds or other versions.

summary: A command-line perceptual image comparison utility that computes multi-scale SSIM dissimilarity and can emit a difference map. Useful for tolerance-based still-image comparisons; its AGPL licensing and commercial licensing option need review for deployment.
use_when: Score perceptual differences between still images
Use when perceptual similarity matters more than exact pixel equality
avoid_when: Use odiff for fast strict pixel-level regression checks
Use ImageMagick compare for a general-purpose image toolbox

assessment.rationale: Official project sources identify 1.3.0 (PyPI) as the latest available version/release (2026-06-18); maintenance assessed from release evidence. Documentation assessment only; no local installation or fixture evidence.
